This post breaks down what GitHub Pages is, how it works, and why it matters for digital product sellers looking for sovereignty and control over their commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-3|The Full]].

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service that allows users to create a website directly from a GitHub repository. For digital creators, this means the ability to set up an online store without incurring hosting costs. Unlike platforms like Gumroad, which charge a 10% fee per sale, GitHub Pages enables you to retain more of your earnings. By integrating with tools like Google Apps Script and NOWPayments, creators can automate the sales process, ensuring product delivery and payment processing without the constraints of traditional payment gateways. This infrastructure allows creators to maintain full control over their digital products and customer interactions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a digital product store using GitHub Pages is straightforward yet powerful. At its core, GitHub Pages serves static content, meaning it can host your product listings and sales pages. Google Apps Script can be integrated for backend logic, handling order processing and automated email delivery. NOWPayments allows creators to accept cryptocurrencies, providing a seamless transaction experience and ensuring payments are verified instantly. This combination eliminates the need for a middleman, allowing creators to own their data and customer relationships fully. With low transaction fees of just 0.5%, you can significantly increase your profit margins compared to conventional platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators across regions facing financial constraints or payment restrictions. If you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or software in countries like Kenya, Bangladesh, or Venezuela, this setup provides a reliable way to monetize your work. The Sovereign Starter Stack, for example, allows you to deploy a fully functional store in just 48 hours. This is essential for creators seeking to bypass the limitations imposed by major payment platforms, ensuring that they can reach their audience and generate revenue without unnecessary fees or complications.
GitHub Pages offers free hosting for your digital product store.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To set up a digital product store using GitHub Pages, you need several key components. First, a GitHub account for hosting your store on GitHub Pages. Next, Google Apps Script to automate functions like order management and product delivery. Finally, NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions and handling payment confirmations. This combination allows for a seamless user experience from browsing to purchase. Each component plays a critical role in ensuring that your store operates smoothly and efficiently, empowering you to focus on creating rather than worrying about logistics.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital product store, start by creating a GitHub account and setting up a new repository for your project. Once your repository is ready, upload your product listings and sales pages. Next, configure Google Apps Script to handle your order processing. Finally, connect your store to NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This process can be completed in just a couple of days, allowing you to start selling products almost immediately. With the Sovereign Starter Stack priced at $97, you can have your store up and running quickly, ensuring that you maintain control over your sales and customer data.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing. This allows you to set up a digital storefront without incurring the high fees associated with traditional platforms, enabling you to retain more of your earnings.
NOWPayments enables seamless cryptocurrency transactions with low fees.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

You can sell an ebook online by using GitHub Pages for hosting your sales page and leveraging NOWPayments to process cryptocurrency transactions. This setup avoids the need for traditional payment platforms and their associated fees.

The best way is to create your own digital store using GitHub Pages and integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. This eliminates platform fees, allowing you to keep a larger percentage of your sales.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up your store using GitHub Pages. By using automation tools like Google Apps Script and accepting payments through NOWPayments, you can efficiently manage your sales without these platforms.
What are the costs associated with using GitHub Pages for my store?
GitHub Pages is free to use for hosting your store. You will incur costs only from the payment processing service, such as NOWPayments, which charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction.
